page_title: ALA 1-0 RAY | Alaves v Rayo Vallecano 10/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+7' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) sees a yellow card from Jose Luis Munuera Montero after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.

90+6' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies onto the right post! The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.

90+6' Jose Luis Munuera Montero interrupts the game. One of the players from Rayo Vallecano won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. It's a free kick to Alaves, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
90+3' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Alaves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+2' Antonio Sivera (Alaves) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
90+1' The game is interrupted now, Antonio Sivera (Alaves) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
88' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) makes a rough challenge and Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle for a foul.
88' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
87' One of the players from Rayo Vallecano times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
86' Inigo Perez prepares a substitution. Jorge de Frutos is replaced by Bebe (Rayo Vallecano).
85' Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
85' Here comes a substitution. Andoni Gorosabel is given a rest as he is replaced by Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves).
84' Kike Garcia (Alaves) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
82' Kike Garcia (Alaves) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
81' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Alaves.
81' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Alaves.
79' Inigo Perez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano) replacing Pathe Ciss.
78' Substitution. Carlos Vicente makes way for Alex Sola (Alaves).
78' A substitution has been made. Jon Guridi is replaced by Carlos Benavidez (Alaves).
74' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
71' Luis Garcia Plaza decides to make a substitution. Samu Omorodion will be replaced by Kike Garcia (Alaves).
71' The referee allows time for a substitution. Luis Rioja will be replaced by Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves).
71' Jon Guridi (Alaves) makes a strong challenge and Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows for a foul.
70' A pass from Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) is intercepted by Antonio Sivera and the move breaks down.
70' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Rayo Vallecano comes to nothing.
69' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Good work from Rayo Vallecano as they win a corner.
69' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano).
67' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
66' A player from Rayo Vallecano commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
65' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Rayo Vallecano.
65' The resulting set piece from Rayo Vallecano is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
64' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes out for a corner. Rayo Vallecano can continue in their attacking effort.
63' Inigo Perez has decided to substitute Kike Perez and he is replaced by Miguel Crespo (Rayo Vallecano).
63' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) comes onto the pitch so that Raul de Tomas can be given a rest.
61' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
59' Samu Omorodion (Alaves) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
58' Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
56' The Alaves players’ celebrations are quickly cut short after referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero signals NO GOAL following the VAR review.
56' Wait! Referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
56' Alaves have a goal ruled out for offside!
55' A quickly taken corner by Alaves.

55' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. Alaves have been awarded a corner kick.
53' Jose Luis Munuera Montero interrupts the game. One of the players from Rayo Vallecano won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
52' The attendance is 16519.

51' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the right side of the goal. Antonio Sivera is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
50' Javi Lopez (Alaves) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Rayo Vallecano will take a free kick.
48' Rayo Vallecano take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
46' Inigo Perez makes a switch. Pep Chavarria is coming on in place of Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) at the start of the second period.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+7' Jose Luis Munuera Montero has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' Luis Rioja (Alaves) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Stole Dimitrievski, who smothers the ball.

45+4' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
45+2' Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
45' 6 additional min. will be played.
44' 1 - 0 GOAL! Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Stole Dimitrievski, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 1:0.
38' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
37' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Alaves earn a free kick.
32' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
30' Jose Luis Munuera Montero shows a yellow card to Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
29' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
28' The booking goes to Abdel Abqar (Alaves).

27' Samu Omorodion (Alaves) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
26' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Alaves, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
26' Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle after Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Alaves are awarded a free kick.

25' Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
24' Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle for a foul after Samu Omorodion (Alaves) hacks down one of his opponents. A free kick to Rayo Vallecano.

22' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it towards the bottom right corner, but Antonio Sivera pulled off a nice save to stop the attempt.
20' Jon Guridi (Alaves) sends a cross into the box, but Stole Dimitrievski comes off his line to gather the ball.
17' Rayo Vallecano take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

17' Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. The ball is out of play and Rayo Vallecano manage to earn a corner.
16' Alaves quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
15' Luis Rioja (Alaves) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
14' Luis Rioja (Alaves) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
13' Today's referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero rightly decides to book Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) for his harsh tackle.
13' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Stole Dimitrievski intercepts the ball.
12' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero saw the whole situation.
11' Alaves can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

11' Jon Guridi (Alaves) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his shot towards the roof of the net, but the keeper makes a superb save! The ball goes out of play. Alaves are awarded a corner kick.

8' A lofted cross from Carlos Vicente (Alaves) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.

7' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
6' Alaves take a short corner kick.
5' A crossfield pass from Antonio Blanco (Alaves) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
5' Alaves have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
5' Javi Lopez (Alaves) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Alaves.
4' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.

3' Samu Omorodion (Alaves) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
2' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.

2' A player from Alaves commits a rough challenge. Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Free kick. Rayo Vallecano will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
1' The match has just started.
